select sum(CASE WHEN es_cobro = 1 THEN monto ELSE -monto END) as aggregate from `recibos` where `deleted_at` is null and date(`created_at`) = '2026-01-25' and `afectar_caja` = 1 and `recibos`.`deleted_at` is null

select sum(CASE WHEN es_cobro = 1 THEN rm.valor ELSE -rm.valor END) as aggregate from `recibos` as `r` inner join `recibos_metodos_pagos` as `rm` on `r`.`id` = `rm`.`id_recibo` inner join `metodos_pagos` as `mp` on `mp`.`id` = `rm`.`id_metodo_pago` where date(`r`.`created_at`) = '2026-01-25' and `r`.`deleted_at` is null and `r`.`afectar_caja` = 1 and (`mp`.`nombre` = 'Efectivo' or `mp`.`nombre` = 'Cheque')
